summary: Jefferson National Forest tower on Stone Mountain, Lee County; a 1977 report said it would be removed, and the FFLA lists it as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone. A 1977 report said the tower was to be removed; no source here confirms the removal.

events.note: Planned removal: the Appalachia Independent reported in 1977 that the tower was to be removed, as cited by a local history. Not confirmed as carried out.

evidence.supports: 1977 report: Olinger Tower, a Jefferson NF lookout on Stone Mountain in Lee County, was to be removed
evidence.quote: In 1977, the Appalachia Independent reported that Olinger Tower, a Jefferson National Forest lookout tower on Stone Mountain in Lee County, was to be removed.

evidence.supports: The 1977 removal ended one practical use of the name, not the name itself
evidence.quote: but not the end of the name itself

evidence.supports: Olinger Gap Trail is a 1.1-mile route linking the Keokee Loop Trail and the Stone Mountain Trail, per Virginia DWR as cited by the history
evidence.quote: identifies the Olinger Gap Trail as a 1.1-mile route connecting the Keokee Loop Trail to the Stone Mountain Trail

evidence.supports: The modern trail still carries the Olinger name
evidence.quote: The modern Olinger Gap Trail keeps the name visible.

evidence.supports: Listed as a tower in Lee County, status Gone

sources.title: Olinger, Lee County: Olinger Gap, Stone Mountain, and a Community Kept in the Records

notes_for_editor: Only two sources. No build date, design, staffing or fire record was found in what was read. The 1977 removal is a report of a plan, so the event is typed other, not removed. The FFLA entry has no register number. Coordinates 36.81205, -82.91691 are the brief's and the FFLA's. Search results also showed a Facebook photo titled 'Fire Tower at Olinger'; it was not opened, so no photo is listed. Not used: search snippets about a Jefferson NF tower that burned on Halloween and was rebuilt (one title names Stone Mountain and High Knob). The FFLA list has a High Knob (JNF, Wise, US 227, VA 6) entry marked gone and another marked standing; the snippet may concern High Knob, not Olinger. Worth a check before anyone links the two.
